motion_blur.setting.enabled.tooltip: Blur what moves on screen. Turned off, the mod does nothing at all.
motion_blur.setting.mode.tooltip: Consistent: the same blur at any FPS. Cinematic: more blur when your FPS is low, like a film camera.
motion_blur.setting.quality.tooltip: Higher looks smoother on fast movement and costs a little more.
motion_blur.setting.max_length.tooltip: How far the blur can stretch on very fast movement.
motion_blur.setting.moving_objects.toolt: Blur moving mobs, players and items too, not only the world as you look around.
motion_blur.setting.hand.tooltip: Blur the first-person hand and held item as they swing and bob.
